roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.summary: Play Chapters 1–5 and their named missions. Make 15 manual saves work for you: preserve a start and end save for each chapter (10 total), rotating the other five during free roam because missions cannot be replayed; cheats disable both trophies and saving. Progress toward the 100% checklist counts during the story, so scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study animals through binoculars early.

roadmap.title: The 100 percent checklist and challenges
roadmap.summary: After the story, open Progress → Stats → 100 percent Completion and clear the checklist. It represents roughly 60% of full-game completion: most side quests and collectible types are unnecessary, and required strands usually need only 70–80%; 70 of 80 challenges suffice, so the hardest can be skipped. Combine robberies, ranges, races, exploration, activity counts and the remaining required collectibles where practical.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.summary: Finish the character finale missions and remaining Strangers and Freaks strands, then mop up feats and money requirements. Anything left remains available in free roam after the story, as quest givers return. Complete A Long Road after checklist work; Vice Got a Price! unlocks automatically once every other trophy is earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all 54 other trophies; PowerPyx rates the platinum route 4/10 and estimates about 200 hours across one playthrough, with no difficulty choice, mission replay, or New Game+. Cheats switch off both trophies and saving. Use the 15 manual slots deliberately: keep chapter-start and chapter-end saves across the five chapters, rotating the remaining slots during free roam; PowerPyx recommends this save routine.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The checklist appears after the story at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but story-era progress already counts and nothing required is missable. Its scope is roughly 60% of the game's full content: most side quests and collectible families are excluded, and required strands generally need only 70–80%. Do optional missions as they appear (including Moses and Randy vehicle deliveries), scan new cars with WAiNK and study animals through binoculars early, and remember each meditation performed with both characters gives two checklist counts. PowerPyx details these shortcuts and checklist requirements.
trophies.caution: Longest trophy; plan around the full checklist and leave it for the stage 3 finale.

Track regional totals at Progress > Activities > Stunts; completed stunts remain marked on the map. PowerPyx outlines the counts and tracking method.

Dive at seven purple chest-marked shipwrecks, use the metal detector to uncover treasure, and return each find; track him at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees or Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. See Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; scanning or entering a wanted vehicle prompts delivery to his green RK garage west of Vice City, and intact cars pay more. Destroy Synthetic Labs at purple Vice City markers through ‘Take Out Kitty Litter’; after enough labs, his second quest, ‘Spin On This’, opens and awards the trophy. trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit the 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating there as both Lucia and Jason makes each location contribute twice. Track them at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and wait until both characters are playable together after Chapter 2's ‘Coffee Break’ for the last spot. In Chapter 1, after ‘Down to Earth’ on a morning, talk to Lucia in Jason's kitchen, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept when prompted to join her meditation. PowerPyx outlines the spot count and the early house sequence.
trophies.caution: The Chapter 1 house meditation is separate from the marked spots: on a morning after ‘Down to Earth’, speak to Lucia in Jason's kitchen; she says she will meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept to join. This adds one to the counter without marking a meditation spot; PowerPyx says whether it is strictly required remains unconfirmed, though it had been completed when the trophy unlocked. The opportunity disappears permanently after Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: After ‘Coffee Break’ unlocks both characters for free roam, keep the wanted level active while robbing three shops consecutively. Bring armor, sticky bombs, and Zombix or Adrenaline healing from Ammu-Nation; the three north Vice City jewelry stores unlocked by Chapter 3's ‘Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs’ form a practical route. Take a couple of items and open each back-room safe; if police arrive after you leave the first shop, a fourth may be needed, and the award can take about 30 seconds after shop three. Scanning traffic from a busy road is a quick way to build the total. There are 557 vehicles at launch and the 100% checklist asks for 200 base models, so this should arrive along the way; check Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. PowerPyx gives the totals and menu path.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one Combat Focus activation: while aiming, press L3+R3 to slow time, expose weak spots, and spend the purple bar. Build focus with food or drink and washing at home, then use Adrenaline to extend it; use body armor and an accurate automatic rifle such as the Duke 556 against gang enemies (police, soldiers, and civilians do not count). Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, and headshots; view it at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus. PowerPyx explains how to prepare and which targets count.

Terminals E3 and E4 are the straightforward targets: enter by the boarding-bridge stairs or through the terminal, reach the cockpit, push back, take off, then fly roughly one kilometre away for the delayed unlock. At Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City, enter through the back with the Snap Gun rather than kicking in the door, read the safe code note in back, empty the safe, destroy the security footage, and disable the alarm in the rear room. trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob and escape from five bank vaults. The Chapter 4 optional ‘That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)’ opens this activity: follow a security van until a guard takes its cash case inside, then enter while the vault is open; bring your partner to hand over a bag with Right. After earlier Yasmani quests, van tips cost $10,000 and mark vans purple; a fast motorcycle and vehicle swap help with the instant four-star pursuit. Eight large bank jobs exist, all needed for the checklist, and each can pay up to $205,000. PowerPyx outlines the opening, escape, and checklist overlap.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through Scooter Bros, the app installed after Chapter 2's ‘Moses’ mission; each registration needs an open garage spot. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and select Respray then Register; initially he only takes vehicles without trackers. From Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray, and inexpensive cars or bikes keep fees low. PowerPyx explains the app, restrictions, and cheaper options.
